title: Slash with a Knife

description.main: A new edition of Yoshitomo Nara's 1999 drawing book, collecting more than 100 drawings and texts made in Los Angeles in the spring of 1998, now with English translations of all the writing.
description.extended:
A new edition of Yoshitomo Nara's 1999 drawing book, a record of the drawings and writing he made in Los Angeles in the spring of 1998.

The book gathers more than 100 works from that stay. Most are drawings of children who stare back at the viewer, done on scraps of notebook paper and envelopes. Short poetic texts from the same months run alongside, and Little More calls the book the starting point of his work. The publisher reissued it in 2023, about 25 years after the drawings were made, with a new cover and English translations of every text. Shigeo Goto planned and edited the book.

Nara (b. 1959, Aomori) studied at Aichi Prefectural University of Fine Arts and then at the Kunstakademie Düsseldorf, and lived in Germany until 2000. He emerged in the 1990s alongside Japanese Pop, and works across painting, drawing, sculpture, photography and installation. His work is held by the Museum of Modern Art, the Los Angeles County Museum of Art and the British Museum, and LACMA organized a touring retrospective of it in 2020.
